gold: Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG)

selector.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components in the left maxillary sinus, along with significant sinus pressure and facial swelling, strongly supports Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma. The biopsy results, while suggestive of Giant Cell Tumor, do not fully align with the clinical presentation.

rejected.why: Insufficient evidence for vasculitis or granulomatous inflammation
